title.narrative: Environmental CS for EU, Young Researchers of Serbia (YRS) 2025-2028
Miljö CS för EU, Young Researchers of Serbia (YRS) 2025-2028

description.narrative:
MAIN OBJECTIVES OF THE STRATEGIC PLAN OF THE YOUNG RESEARCHERS OF SERBIA
Programme strategic objectives (PSO)
Organisational strategic objectives (OSO)
PSO1. Volunteering has been recognised as an important tool for community development, and mechanisms and volunteering programmes have been set in place throughout Serbia that contribute to strengthening society's capacities for sustainable development.
OSO1. Improved organisational structure and empowered human resources necessary for the realisation of strategic programme objectives
PSO2. Empowered civil society, with greater influence and competence to take part in the decision-making processes in an informed manner and to implement activities aimed at environmental protection and community development.
OSO2. Established system for monitoring the effects of work and capacity development.
PSO3. Increased personal responsibility and competences of citizens in relation to the environment as a result of innovative educational programs.
OSO3. Developed capacities for public representation of employees and associates and defined representation and communication strategy.

Insatsen ska stödja ett livskraftigt, pluralistiskt och oberoende civilsamhälle och främja demokratiskt deltagande, och verksamheten ska bidra till att öka möjligheterna för en utveckling som är miljömässigt och klimatmässigt hållbar, inklusive ett hållbart nyttjande av naturresurser. Detta ligger i linje med regeringens reformagenda för att biståndet ska bli mer långsiktigt i sin ansats, transparent och effektivt (21 december 2023 beslutade regeringen om inriktningen för Sidas verksamhet och de finansiella förutsättningarna för svenskt bistånd för år 2024).

The contribution shall support a viable, pluralistic and independent civil society and promote democratic participation, and the activities shall contribute to increasing the opportunities for development that is environmentally and climate-wise sustainable, including the sustainable use of natural resources. This is in line with the government's reform agenda for aid to be more long-term in its approach, transparent and effective (21 December 2023 the government decided on the direction of Sida's operations and the financial conditions for Swedish aid for the year 2024).
